<Highlight>【星灵奇装】</>
群星璀璨之时，星光加身一刻，美将再现于此。

<Highlight>【召唤规则】</>
使用星币进行灵界召唤，概率获得珍贵的宝物奖励。
奖励分为<Highlight>神眷</>、<Highlight>灵幻</>、<Highlight>非凡</>三档。累计使用<Highlight>10</>个星币且未获得神眷奖励后，神眷概率逐渐增加，每使用<Highlight>40个</>星币必定获得<Highlight>神眷</>奖励，每使用<Highlight>10个</>星币必定获得<Highlight>灵幻</>奖励。
召唤获得的奖励均无法交易或赠送。

<Highlight>【其它规则】</>
使用<Highlight>裁刀</>可以在星灵秘库商店兑换奖励，获得超过拥有上限的灵幻或神眷档次外观奖励时，将会被分解为特定数量的<Highlight>裁刀</>。
获得神眷品质奖励时，将<Highlight>优先获得未拥有</>的外观奖励（神眷发型与时装散件分开计算），可在外观收集进度中查看详情。

<Highlight>【概率公示】</>
神眷奖励概率（含保底）：5.230%
<Highlight>神眷发型</>：0.596%
<Highlight>神眷时装散件</>：4.634%

灵幻奖励概率（含保底）：12.222%
风暴之泪、玫瑰藤杖、栖蝶披风、蔷薇之缚、银蔷薇

非凡奖励概率（含保底）：82.548%
聚合因子、泡沫染膏、珊瑚染料、爆爆烟花、彩带烟花、派对烟花、古怪的药剂、简易的火把、纯情鲁特琴、小象玩偶、冰冷的裹布、荣耀的传承、卷毛狒狒的毛发、幸运大转盘、贝壳项链、珍珠胸花
ref_en:
<Highlight>【Star Spirit Exotic Attire】</>
When the stars shine bright and starlight descends, beauty shall reappear here.

<Highlight>【Summoning Rules】</>
Use Star Coins to perform Spirit World summoning for a chance to obtain precious treasure rewards.
Rewards are divided into three tiers: <Highlight>God's Favor</>, <Highlight>Spirit Illusion</>, and <Highlight>Beyonder</>. After using a total of <Highlight>10</> Star Coins without obtaining a God's Favor reward, the probability of obtaining one will gradually increase. Every <Highlight>40</> Star Coins used guarantees a <Highlight>God's Favor</> reward, and every <Highlight>10</> Star Coins used guarantees a <Highlight>Spirit Illusion</> reward.
 Rewards obtained from summoning cannot be traded or gifted.

<Highlight>【Other Rules】</>
Use <Highlight>Cutting Blades</> to exchange for rewards in the Star Spirit Secret Vault Shop. If you obtain a Spirit Illusion or God's Favor tier cosmetic reward that exceeds your ownership limit, it will be decomposed into a specific number of <Highlight>Cutting Blades</>.
When obtaining a God's Favor quality reward, you will <Highlight>prioritize obtaining unowned</> cosmetic rewards (God's Favor hairstyles and outfit pieces are calculated separately). You can view details in the Cosmetic Collection Progress.

<Highlight>【Probability Disclosure】</>
God's Favor reward probability (including pity): 5.230%
<Highlight>God's Favor Hairstyle</>: 0.596%
<Highlight>God's Favor Outfit Piece</>: 4.634%

Spirit Illusion reward probability (including pity): 12.222%
Storm's Tear, Rose Vine Staff, Butterfly-Perching Cape, Rose Binding, Silver Rose

Beyonder reward probability (including pity): 82.548%
Aggregation Factor, Foam Dye, Coral Dye, Pop Fireworks, Ribbon Fireworks, Party Fireworks, Eccentric Potion, Simple Torch, Innocent Lute, Elephant Doll, Cold Shroud, Glorious Inheritance, Curly-Haired Baboon Hair, Lucky Big Wheel, Seashell Necklace, Pearl Corsage

1.每个人非肉体的部分分为四层，最核心叫精神体，也就是每个人最根本的灵性，万物有灵派认为，凡是生物都有灵性，都有精神体。
2.精神体之外是星灵体，它是前者与灵界、与星空沟通的方式，属于前者的外在表现，和你当前的情绪直接相关，也是占卜的根源。
3.再往外是心智体，与肉体结合。它牵涉头脑，属于你推理能力、思考能力、洞察能力和认识事物能力的综合呈现。
4.最外层是以太体，它是你生命能量和肉体状态的表现，你看到的气场颜色就是以太体的外显象征。
ref_en:
1. Everyone's non-physical part is divided into four layers. The core is called the Spirit Body, which is everyone's fundamental spirituality. The School of All Things Have Spirit believes that all living beings have spirituality and a spirit body. 
 2. Outside the spirit body is the Astral Projection, which is the way the former communicates with the Spirit World and the starry sky. It belongs to the external manifestation of the former and is directly related to your current emotions; it is also the root of divination root. 
 3. Further out is the Mental Body, combined with the physical body. It involves the mind and belongs to the comprehensive presentation of your reasoning ability, thinking ability, insight, and ability to understand things. 
 4. The outermost layer is the Ether Body, which is the manifestation of your life energy and physical state. The aura color you see is the external symbol of the Ether Body.

<FaintYellow>强化</>：伤害基础值提高至*d点，折射次数增加1次且折射时伤害不再衰减，只命中一个目标时伤害提升至*d点。使所有命中目标的buffdisc(*id)点，持续<HighLight>3.5</>秒；有<HighLight>70%</>基础概率使其移速降低<HighLight>50%</>，持续<HighLight>2.5</>秒。释放非强化的<HighLight>光之折射</>时返还<HighLight>2</>秒冷却时间。
<FaintYellow>神秘知识</>：最多拥有100点。达到100点时解锁<HighLight>终结技能信息洪流</>。
ref_en:
Fire a beam at the locked target to deal *d magic damage. The beam will refract to nearby enemy targets up to 3 <HighLight></> times, with each refraction reducing the beam's damage to the next target by 5% <HighLight></>. The beam has a 60% <HighLight></> base probability of applying Stagnation <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="6"></> for 0.7 <HighLight></> seconds; if it only hits one target, damage is increased to *d. Gain 20 points of Mysterious Knowledge <HighLight></> after casting. When you possess Knowledge Infusion <HighLight></>, this skill gains Strengthening <HighLight></>. 

<FaintYellow> Strengthening </>: Base damage increased to *d, refraction count increased by 1, and damage no longer decays upon refraction. If it only hits one target, damage is increased to *d. Applies buffdisc(*id) to all hit targets for 3.5 <HighLight></> seconds; has a 70% <HighLight></> base probability of reducing their movement speed by 50% <HighLight></> for 2.5 <HighLight></> seconds. Casting a non-strengthened Refraction of Light <HighLight></> refunds 2 <HighLight></> seconds of Cooldown. 
<FaintYellow> Mysterious Knowledge </>: Maximum of 100 points. Upon reaching 100 points, unlock the Finisher Skill Vortex of Knowledge <HighLight></>.

路德维尔这辈子——如果成为秘偶之后还能算作这辈子的延续——没见过这么多蚊子。
它们围着他嗡嗡叫，像一群闻到大餐的饿鬼。但"地狱上将"面无表情。
“绿华”戒指在他手指上闪着温润的光。
对一位秘偶来说，这能治愈疾病的神奇物品，其副作用并不太大。
克莱恩站在十米外，看着这幅画面，由衷地感叹："还好不是我戴。"
这就是秘偶大师的智慧：让不怕咬的人去戴招蚊子的戒指。分工明确，皆大欢喜。
ref_en:
Ludwell had never seen so many mosquitoes in his life—if one could still call it a life after becoming a marionette. 
 They buzzed around him like a group of hungry ghosts that had smelled a feast. But the "Admiral of Hell" was expressionless. 
 The "Green Bloom" ring shone with a warm light on his finger. 
 For a marionette, this mystical item that could cure diseases didn't have too great a side effect. 
 Klein stood ten meters away, watching this scene, and sighed sincerely: "It's a good thing I'm not the one wearing it." 
 This is the wisdom of a Marionettist: let someone who isn't afraid of being bitten wear the ring that attracts mosquitoes. The division of labor is clear, and everyone is happy.

铁十字街下街的苔丝老太太缝制这个布偶时，手指早已佝偻变形。
黑色的宫廷长裙，深邃的眼眸，紧抿的嘴唇——她倾尽了最后的手艺，却没人知道为什么要把它做得如此精致。
“多少钱？”一位绅士问。
“换一瓶毒堇汁。”老太太说。
交易完成了。那天晚上，苔丝老太太和病重的丈夫一起喝下了毒药，带着解脱的微笑闭上了双眼。
三天后，那位绅士在街上被马车撞倒。
一周后，他的妻子突患重病。
两周后，他的店铺失火。
当值夜者找到他时，绅士已经疯了，死死抱着那个布偶，喃喃自语：“是她……她把所有的不幸都缝进去了……”
布偶的裙摆上，污痕隐约是泪水的形状。
ref_en:
When old Mrs. Tess of Iron Cross Street in the Lower Street sewed this doll, her fingers were already crooked and deformed. 
 A black court dress, deep eyes, tightly pursed lips—she poured all her remaining craftsmanship into it, yet no one knew why she had made it so exquisite. 
 "How much?" a gentleman asked. 
 "Trade it for a bottle of hemlock juice," the old lady said. 
 The transaction was completed. That night, old Mrs. Tess and her critically ill husband drank the poison together, closing their eyes with a smile of relief. 
 Three days later, the gentleman was hit by a carriage on the street. 
 A week later, his wife fell suddenly ill. 
 Two weeks later, his shop caught fire. 
 When the Nighthawks found him, the gentleman was already insane, clutching the doll tightly and muttering: "It's her... she sewed all the misfortune into it..." 
 On the hem of the doll's dress, the stains were vaguely in the shape of tears.

ref_en:
To the unfortunately defeated %s:
      How interesting, watching you be repeatedly tormented by the Dark Demonic Wolf, I cannot help but recall some happy times—back then, the respected Mr. "Fool" was just like you; He first ▇ ▇ ▇ and then ▇ ▇ ▇, and even ▇ ▇ ▇ ▇ ▇, leaving me with many wonderful memories. 
      As a token of gratitude, I also provided Him with a handsome reward. Since you are the heir to His will, I am willing to provide some reliable help: follow the <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302126">Records of the Dark Demonic Wolf</> to engage in battle, or choose this perfectly timed strategy I have attached to the end of the letter, and you will easily achieve victory.

亲爱的非凡者：
      欢迎您来到这片交织隐秘与启示的世界，愿灵性为您指引前路。
      尽管这是初次步入此间，但您或许已经对眼前徐徐展开的世界有了独特的感知与构想。我们始终以敬畏之心观察并记录着一切——您在此间每一瞬的所见、所思与所感，在我们看来皆是珍贵的启示。在此，我们诚邀您通过信件中的隐秘通道，向我们传达您的想法。

ref_en:
<M_Red>「Complete the questionnaire and receive 200 Bound Pounds!」</>
<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="web=%s">Public Beta Survey 1</>
Dear Beyonder:
      Welcome to this world intertwined with secrets and revelations. May your spirituality guide your path. 
      Although this is your first time stepping into this place, you may already have unique perceptions and ideas about the world unfolding before you. We always observe and record everything with awe—every moment of what you see, think, and feel here is a precious revelation to us. Here, we sincerely invite you to convey your thoughts to us through the secret channel in the letter. 
      Thank you for the changes you have brought to this world. May you digest your potion and master your Extraordinary powers soon.

<Title>属性补足加成</>
队伍或团队中，拥有相同家族成员时，获得属性增益。团队内同家族成员数量越多，增益效果越高。离开家族后有24小时的生效冷却期。
ref_en:
<Title>Resurrection Count Bonus</>
If 3–8 people in a party or team belong to the same Family, gain 1 extra resurrection attempt; if 9 or more people belong to the same Family, gain 2 extra resurrection attempts. There is a 24-hour cooldown period after leaving a Family.
<Title>Attribute Supplement Bonus</>
If there are members of the same Family in a party or team, gain attribute bonuses. The more members of the same Family in the team, the higher the bonus effect. There is a 24-hour cooldown period after leaving a Family.

ref_en:
To %s: 
 Do not be discouraged. Strong enemies like Ray Bieber will always appear on the path of growth. As long as no one sacrifices themselves because of this, everything is still in time. There are many records of Ray Bieber in the Church's archives, which might help you: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302101">Records of Ray Bieber</>
 Trust your teammates. On the path of the Extraordinary filled with madness, they are the backs you can rely on, and you also need to grow up as soon as possible to become an outstanding Nighthawk. source_cn:
当大家准备散场的时候，有人大喊——戈登失踪了。
是戴维的声音，据他所说，他们本来在一起喝酒的，戈登突然就不见了。
曼斯教授让所有人都帮忙找，我们从营地找到营地外，都没有找到。
正当所有人都回到营地后，戴维也不见了。
戈登和戴维是最先发现山顶遗迹的人，也是最早失踪的。营地里去过山顶遗迹的人，都担心下一个失踪的是自己。
尽管接下来的几天里没有人失踪，但曼斯教授和几位研究员先生都提议先暂时撤离，我们只好收拾东西，准备离开。
ref_en:
When everyone was preparing to leave, someone shouted—Gordon is missing.
It was Davy's voice. According to him, they were drinking together, and Gordon suddenly disappeared.
Professor Mans asked everyone to help look for him. We searched from the camp to outside the camp, but couldn't find him.
Just as everyone returned to the camp, Davy disappeared too.
Gordon and Davy were the first to discover the ruins on the mountain and were also the first to go missing. Everyone in the camp who had been to the ruins on the mountain was worried that they would be the next to go missing.
Although no one went missing in the following days, Professor Mans and several researchers suggested evacuating first, so we had to pack our things and prepare to leave.

source_cn: Hello, {{英俊的先生|优雅的女士}}.

<InvDefault_HW>它惊讶地发现身上覆盖着全新的羽毛——银白色的，如雾般轻盈蓬松。邓恩安静地守在落叶堆旁，角上依然挂着木牌，最新一块刻着：“戴莉拥有了一身新的羽毛，记得赞美它。”</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>后来，森林里流传着这样的故事：这里有两位守护者，深沉的鹿蹄声和清亮的鸟叫声完美交融，它们在歌声和鹿角中记录每一朵花的绽放，每条溪流的改道和每个生命的成长。</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>邓恩的遗忘还在循环，但它每天都赞美戴莉的羽毛；戴莉的羽毛不再随歌声掉落，每段旋律都让羽毛更有光泽。</>
ref_en:
<InvDefault_HW>It was surprised to find its body covered in brand-new feathers—silver-white, as light and fluffy as mist. Dunn stood guard quietly beside the pile of leaves, with the wooden plaques still hanging on its antlers. The newest one was engraved with: "Daly has a new set of feathers; remember to praise her."</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>Later, such a story circulated in the forest: there are two Guardians here, the deep sound of deer hooves and the clear birdsong blending perfectly. They record every blooming flower, the diversion of every stream, and the growth of every life in their songs and on their antlers.</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>Dunn's forgetting still cycles, but it praises Daly's feathers every day; Daly's feathers no longer fall out with her singing, and every melody makes the feathers more lustrous.</>

source_cn: 养了灵体宠物，淘的古玩越来越多以后，我觉得我逐渐有了某种"通灵"能力。我这几天心脏扑通扑通跳，平时去镇外的工厂工作回家，都不敢走古堡那条路。今天看镇上的告示板说，一个低序列居民一家四口被杀了，我居然尤其联想到，会不会我就是下一个呢？我有种预感，今晚有大事发生。不过多亏了我淘的那些古玩，还有我可爱的灵蛇灵鼠们，我现在特别兴奋，就好像，有人会帮我解决这些事一样……我会把窗门好好关上，把“那个东西”放在床边，万一真的来了，我就……
ref_en: After keeping spirit pets and collecting more and more antiques, I feel that I have gradually developed a kind of "mediumship" ability. My heart has been thumping these past few days. When I go home from work at the factory outside the town, I don't dare to take the road by the ancient castle. Seeing the notice board in town today, it said that a family of four, who were low-sequence residents, had been killed. I actually especially associated it with whether I would be the next one? I have a premonition that something big will happen tonight. But thanks to the antiques I collected, and my cute spirit snakes and spirit mice, I am especially excited now, as if someone will help me solve these things... I will close the windows and doors tightly and put "that thing" by the bed. If it really comes, I will...

source_cn:
恭逢黑夜女神诞辰圣祭，圣赛缪尔教堂谨定于冬礼日举行守夜弥撒。现将当日活动安排敬告如下：

时间：晚间10:00 准时开始
地点：圣赛缪尔教堂前广场（若遇雨雪，移至教堂正厅）
主持：安东尼·史蒂文森主教

注意事项（请务必遵守）：
守夜弥撒是我主诞辰最为神圣的仪式，请诸位信众严肃对待：
1. 请勿迟到。弥撒准点开启，迟到者须在广场外围静立等候，待特定环节结束后方可入场。
2. 保持肃静。仪式期间禁止交谈、喧哗、随意走动。
3. 着装得体。建议穿着深色或素色正装，避免鲜艳色彩。
4. 遵从引导。现场侍从将引导站位与跪拜次序，请予配合。
ref_en:
In celebration of the Evernight Goddess's birthday, St. Samuel Cathedral has scheduled a Vigil Mass for Winter's Eve. The event schedule for the day is as follows: 

Time: 10:00 PM Sharp
Location: Plaza in front of St. Samuel Cathedral (In case of rain or snow, it will be moved to the main hall of the cathedral)
Officiant: Bishop Anthony Stevenson

Notes (Please strictly adhere to these):
The Vigil Mass is the most sacred ceremony of our Lord's birth; please treat it with solemnity:
1. Do not be late. The Mass will start on time. Latecomers must wait quietly outside the plaza and may only enter after specific segments conclude.
2. Maintain silence. Talking, making noise, or walking around freely is prohibited during the ceremony.
3. Dress appropriately. It is recommended to wear dark or plain formal attire; avoid bright colors.
4. Follow guidance. Attendants on-site will guide standing positions and kneeling order; please cooperate.

source_cn:
<Title_HW>十一月十八日</>
　　真是件神奇的事情，一个异想天开的实验和一个偶然出现的失误，让我发现了一位困于风暴之中、迷失于黑暗深处的可怜家伙，他甚至只能在每个月满月的时候才能稍微靠近现实世界，可依然无法将他的呼喊传递进来。
　　他是幸运的，他遇见了我——这个时代的主角。
　　写完上面这段话，自己读了一遍，忽然有点唏嘘，哪怕是用汉字，也不知不觉带上了浓烈的翻译腔，四十年弹指一挥间啊，以往的记忆真的就像梦一样了。
　　……
ref_en:
<Title_HW> November 18 </> 
 It is truly a magical thing. A whimsical experiment and an accidental mistake allowed me to discover a poor guy trapped in a storm and lost in the depths of darkness. He can only get close to the real world during the full moon every month, yet he still cannot convey his cries. 
 He is lucky; he met me—the protagonist of this era. 
 After writing the above paragraph and reading it myself, I suddenly felt a bit emotional. Even when using Chinese, I unknowingly adopted a strong translation tone. Forty years have passed in a flash; past memories really are like a dream. 
 ...

source_cn:
攻击方的攻击会根据双方的破甲-护甲对抗进行数值修正。
自身护甲超过伤害来源破甲的4倍时，每1点护甲降低伤害来源1点攻击。
自身护甲超过伤害来源破甲，但低于伤害来源破甲的4倍时，每3点护甲降低伤害来源2点攻击。
自身护甲低于伤害来源破甲时，每3点护甲降低伤害来源1点攻击。
ref_en:
The attacker's attack will be numerically adjusted based on the Armor Break vs. Armor confrontation between both parties. 
 When your own Armor exceeds 4 times the damage source's Armor Break, every 1 point of Armor reduces the damage source's attack by 1 point. 
 When your own Armor exceeds the damage source's Armor Break but is less than 4 times the damage source's Armor Break, every 3 points of Armor reduces the damage source's attack by 2 points. 
 When your own Armor is less than the damage source's Armor Break, every 3 points of Armor reduces the damage source's attack by 1 point.

source_cn: 黑荆棘接工厂工人失踪案，弗莱委托你前往拉姆德古堡调查第三名失踪者亚瑟。你抵达后触发灵视，目睹阿兹克从棺材中苏醒。他正调查“永暗蜡烛”引发的自杀潮，已救下六人。你发现亚瑟被蜡烛污染企图自杀，阿兹克救治后资助他回家。线索指向蜡烛工坊学徒芬恩，他告诉你幕后黑手将在墓地广场举行死亡庆典。庆典上，你与阿兹克揭穿主持者托马斯神父——他扭曲黑夜女神教义，妄图用永暗蜡烛逃避死亡。托马斯失控逃入冥界，你随阿兹克追击。阿兹克点亮蜡烛驱散黑暗，击败托马斯。芬恩用老师维斯塔的蜡烛替换了邪异蜡烛，救了众人。阿兹克看着烛光，回忆起人性中明亮温暖的片段，点出了死亡与生命的意义。
ref_en: Blackthorn takes on a case of missing factory workers, and Frye entrusts you to go to Lamud Castle to investigate the third missing person, Arthur. Upon arrival, you trigger spirit vision and witness Azik waking up from a coffin. He is investigating the suicide wave caused by the "Evernight Candle" and has already saved six people. You discover that Arthur was contaminated by the candle and attempted suicide; after Azik treats him, he provides funds for him to return home. The clues point to the apprentice Finn of the candle workshop, who tells you that the mastermind will hold a death celebration at the cemetery square. At the celebration, you and Azik expose Father Thomas, the host—he distorted the teachings of the Evernight Goddess, attempting to use the Evernight Candle to escape death. Thomas loses control and flees into the Underworld, and you pursue him with Azik. Azik lights the candle to dispel the darkness and defeats Thomas. Finn replaces the evil candle with his teacher Vista's candle, saving everyone. Looking at the candlelight, Azik recalls the bright and warm fragments of humanity, pointing out the meaning of death and life.

Please read this announcement carefully! 
 Our Old John is dead. Regardless of whether you know him or not, there is something strange still on Old John!

source_cn: 发起宣战</> 1.可发起宣战的时间为：<Highlight>周一至周五17:00-23:00；周六至周日11:00-23:00</>。 2.可宣战的时间点为：<Highlight>周一至周四12:00-14:00、20:00-23:00；周五12:00-14:00、21:00-23:00；周六至周日12:00-18:00、22:00-23:00</>。 3.发起宣战将消耗俱乐部资金，资金根据俱乐部等级、实力差别及血仇值进行扣除。 4.若宣战方获胜，则返还<Highlight>30%</>俱乐部资金，失败则不返还；若被宣战方失败则根据俱乐部等级扣除相应资金，获胜则不扣除。 5.若连续宣战同一俱乐部并获胜，再次宣战消耗俱乐部资金将提升<Highlight>（每周一8点重置）</>。 6.若连续被同一俱乐部宣战并失败，再次被宣战消耗俱乐部资金将减少<Highlight>（每周一8点重置）</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>玩法介绍</> 1.俱乐部宣战将在霍纳奇斯山脉大世界地图进行自由战斗，宣战开始后，仅互相宣战的双方互相进入对决状态。 2.立旗：发起方首先获得立旗权，<Highlight>（会长、副会长、理事）</>中任意一人立旗后，俱乐部立旗技能将消失。立旗后在旗帜周围根据存活时间以获得积分。 3.旗帜轮换：旗帜归属时间结束后，立旗权将轮换至对方俱乐部，或可以通过<Highlight>抢旗成功</>后轮换立旗权。 4.击败对手或参与击败对手，也将获得积分。 5.整场宣战将持续<Highlight>30分钟</>，结算时积分高的一方获胜，若分数相同，则被发起宣战的一方获胜。 6.宣战期间，可使用<Highlight>"集结·俱乐部宣战"</>道具在霍纳奇斯山脉中<Highlight>发起集结</>，道具可在同行商店-俱乐部中查看。
ref_en: Initiate War Declaration</> 1. The time to initiate a war declaration is: <Highlight>Monday to Friday 17:00-23:00; Saturday to Sunday 11:00-23:00</>. 2. The time points for declaring war are: <Highlight>Monday to Thursday 12:00-14:00, 20:00-23:00; Friday 12:00-14:00, 21:00-23:00; Saturday to Sunday 12:00-18:00, 22:00-23:00</>. 3. Initiating a war declaration will consume Club Funds, which are deducted based on the club's level, strength difference, and Blood Feud value. 4. If the declaring party wins, <Highlight>30%</> of the Club Funds will be refunded; if they lose, they will not be refunded. If the declared party loses, corresponding funds will be deducted based on the club's level; if they win, no funds will be deducted. 5. If you continuously declare war on the same club and win, the Club Funds consumed for declaring war again will increase <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. 6. If you are continuously declared war on by the same club and lose, the Club Funds consumed for being declared war on again will decrease <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Gameplay Introduction</> 1. Club war declaration will take place in the Hornacis Mountain Range open world map for free combat. After the war declaration begins, only the two parties who declared war on each other will enter a duel state. 2. Plant Flag: The initiating party first obtains the right to plant the flag. After any one of the <Highlight>(President, Vice President, Director)</> plants the flag, the club's flag-planting skill will disappear. After planting the flag, you will gain points based on the survival time around the flag. 3. Flag Rotation: After the flag ownership time ends, the right to plant the flag will rotate to the other club, or the right to plant the flag can be rotated after <Highlight>successfully seizing the flag</>. 4. Defeating opponents or participating in defeating opponents will also grant points. 5. The entire war declaration will last for <Highlight>30 minutes</>. At the time of settlement, the party with the higher points wins. If the scores are the same, the party that was declared war on wins. 6. During the war declaration, you can use the <Highlight>"Assemble - Club War Declaration"</> item to <Highlight>initiate an assembly</> in the Hornacis Mountain Range. The item can be viewed in the Companion Shop - Club.

我们把东西都收拾好，准备启程。

剩余物资：
面包3份
肉干和肉肠2份
糖1罐 尼尔昨晚外出了一趟，回来的时候吃了几颗
黄油2块 山上太冷，我们昨晚把黄油涂抹在面包上，并且放在火上烤着吃
酒1瓶 水太重了，只留一瓶等登顶后庆祝
水3瓶
ref_en:
It snowed all night. When we woke up in the morning, the tent was half buried. Neil suggested we set off early to speed up the journey, as supplies might not be enough if we consider accidents.
We packed everything up and prepared to set off.

Remaining supplies:
Bread 3 portions
Beef jerky and meat sausage 2 portions
Sugar 1 jar Neil went out last night and ate a few pieces when he came back
Butter 2 blocks It was too cold on the mountain, we spread the butter on the bread last night and roasted it over the fire to eat
Wine 1 bottle Water is too heavy, only kept one bottle to celebrate after reaching the summit
Water 3 bottles

source_cn: 如同月光织就的十四行诗，每个转身都在续写未完的华美乐章。
ref_en: Like a sonnet woven from moonlight, every turn continues to write an unfinished, magnificent movement.

source_cn: 如果你找到了，一定要告诉他们——这个规则一点也不公平……下次要改成只数八十，不，五十！
ref_en: If you find them, you must tell them—this rule isn't fair at all... next time we have to change it to counting to eighty, no, fifty!

source_cn: 小子爵的思念残留，触碰4次灵性残留时，或许能净化心中的黑暗。
ref_en: Young Viscount's lingering thoughts; touching 4 spiritual residues might purify the darkness in the heart.
Hello, little bird! Hello, little flower!
Prologue walkthrough version - Stone sarcophagus shattered

source_cn: 当前家族的申请列表已达上限
ref_en: The application list for the current Family has reached the limit.

source_cn: 恭喜您成为前%d名回答正确的非凡者！奖励已发送至您的背包。

source_cn: 悲伤、喜悦、疲惫、轻快……黄昏平等地照耀在行人身上。
ref_en: Sadness, joy, fatigue, lightness... The dusk shines equally on the pedestrians.
May the Evernight Goddess protect you!

source_cn: 我不要多，就两瓶，卖给我嘛！
ref_en: I don't want much, just two bottles, sell them to me!

source_cn: 我去了几次后忙着工作的事就没再去了，昨天警察也来找我调查过。
ref_en: I went a few times, but then I got busy with work and stopped going. The police also came to investigate me yesterday.

source_cn: 我死了。准确地说，我被第十一个被诅咒害死的人害死了！
ref_en: I am dead. To be precise, I was killed by the person who was killed by the curse after the tenth victim!

source_cn: 所以现在看起来，你们对“愚者”先生都很尊敬？
ref_en: So it seems that you all respect Mr. Fool very much now?

source_cn: 所以，<P_Heart>（严肃）</>在非凡世界一定要——“小心观众”。

source_cn: 明明你才是新人，但我躺着，你站着，这显得我很弱。

ref_en: Heh, double pay? He said that last time too, but only gave 2 extra pennies, not even enough to buy a cup of cheap beer.

ref_en: Haha, you move like a lame quail.

source_cn: 奋勇当先的人， 为俱乐部默默奔走的人， 在关键时刻挺身而出的人——\n贡献足够，名字便会出现在这里。 贡献不再，也可能悄然离去。\n光晕公平，一如灰雾之上的目光。
ref_en: Those who forge ahead, those who work silently for the Club, those who step up at critical moments—\n if the contribution is sufficient, the name will appear here. If the contribution is no longer there, it may quietly leave. \n The radiance is fair, just like the gaze above the gray fog.

source_cn: 如果你打算光看不买，请不要打扰我的生意。

Movement speed and Basic Attack Attack Speed are increased; when a Basic Attack hits, there is a probability of striking the target with lightning, causing damage and Stagnation. source_cn: 参与副本<Highlight>五月庄园·城堡（普通）</>，有概率获得<Highlight>64装等</>的<Highlight>橙色品质装备</>。
ref_en: Participate in the dungeon <Highlight>May Manor · Castle (Normal)</>. There is a chance to obtain <Highlight>Item Level 64</> <Highlight>Orange Quality Equipment</>.

source_cn: 又是划船，这都第八次了。
ref_en: Boating again, this is the eighth time.

source_cn: 反驳的就是你，你这头因蒂斯猪！
ref_en: I'm arguing with you, you Intis pig!

source_cn: 只需要略施小计，战争的结果就可扭转！
ref_en: With just a small trick, the outcome of the war can be reversed!
The name cannot be less than %d characters.

source_cn: 和疯疯癫癫的女工对话
ref_en: Talk to the deranged female worker

source_cn: 哈灵顿先生，那个一掷千金的哈灵顿先生。上周给教会开了张支票，数字写得漂亮极了。人们都说他简直是又一个道恩·唐泰斯！
ref_en: Mr. Harrington, that Mr. Harrington who threw money around like water. He wrote a check to the church last week with a beautiful number on it. People were saying he was practically another Dwayne Dantes!

source_cn: 喂，你真的想买内部资料？
ref_en: Hey, do you really want to buy internal information?

source_cn: 圣光净化/圣焰焚净冷却时长减少5秒。
ref_en: Holy Light Purification/Holy Flame Cleansing cooldown reduced by 5 seconds.

source_cn: 坐起来很舒适。\r\n伟大的发明，不错的马桶！
ref_en: It's comfortable to sit on. A great invention, a nice toilet!

source_cn: 天哪——谢谢你，尊敬的先生/小姐，感谢你的祝福。到时候——
ref_en: Oh my—thank you, respected sir/lady, thank you for your blessings. When the time comes—

source_cn: 妈妈，爸爸会在下一辆车上吗？
ref_en: Mom, will Dad be on the next carriage?

source_cn: 它给整个金秋湖带来丰饶，但同时也伴随着疯狂。
ref_en: It brings abundance to the entire Golden Autumn Lake, but it is also accompanied by madness.

source_cn: 希罗多德先生，我想借阅《封印物3-888现存90种机关谜题破解法》。
ref_en: Mr. Herodotus, I would like to borrow "90 Existing Mechanism Puzzle Solutions for Sealed Artifact 3-888".

source_cn: 当前人机副本数量过多，已自动转为组队模式
ref_en: Too many AI dungeons currently active, automatically switched to party mode.

source_cn: 很好。如果战斗需要用到符咒，只要诵念咒文，灌注灵性后在三秒内丢向目标就可以了。
ref_en: Very good. If you need to use a charm in battle, just chant the incantation, infuse it with spirituality, and throw it at the target within three seconds.

source_cn: 怎么可能是因蒂斯！姐姐说因蒂斯人说的话和我们不一样呀！而且这个曲子多快乐！听起来就是我们鲁恩的。
ref_en: How could it be Intis! Sister said that the language Intis people speak is different from ours! And this piece is so happy! It sounds like it's from our Loen.

source_cn: 想要听一曲，来感受这美好的一天吗？
ref_en: Would you like to listen to a tune and feel this wonderful day?

source_cn: 愚者之梦-失控窥秘人-找到所有书架召唤衍生怪
ref_en: Fool's Dream-Out-of-control Seer-Find All Bookshelves to Summon Derivative Monster

source_cn: 我们要罢工！我们值得更好！值得更多！
ref_en: We must strike! We deserve better! We deserve more!

source_cn: 我好像迷路了……这里的积雪比我来时要厚得多，干净得多。
ref_en: I think I'm lost... The snow here is much thicker and cleaner than when I first arrived.

source_cn: 手势递出邀请，眼神却悄悄点燃了试探的火星。
ref_en: The gesture extends an invitation, but the eyes quietly ignite sparks of testing.

source_cn: 掌握魔法、巫术、占星术等神秘知识，懂得不少仪式魔法。拥有“窥秘之眼”，能看到更多不该看到的东西，因此必须对非凡力量保持敬畏。
ref_en: Master mysterious knowledge such as magic, witchcraft, and astrology, and understand quite a bit of Ritual Magic. Possess 'Eyes of Mystery Prying', capable of seeing more things that should not be seen; therefore, you must maintain awe for Beyonder power.

source_cn: 新配方可解锁：油画小作配方
ref_en: New recipe unlockable: Small Oil Painting Recipe

source_cn: 是啊，他改变了整个时代。不过《廷根市老实人报》为什么会突然开始报道罗塞尔大帝的事迹？
ref_en: Yeah, he changed the whole era. But why would the 'Tingen Honest Man's Newspaper' suddenly start reporting on Emperor Roselle's deeds?

source_cn: 最后一次使用马桶的人是谁？
ref_en: Who was the last person to use the toilet?

source_cn: 有缘人“困于东侧摇篮的时光”？占卜师说话狗屁不通！
ref_en: A fated person 'trapped in the time of the cradle on the east side'? Diviners talk nonsense!
As expected... it's a word that cannot be spoken...

source_cn: 没什么。<P_Heart>（他是不是犯了厨房大忌……灵机一动？）</>
ref_en: It's nothing. <P_Heart> (Did he commit a kitchen taboo... a sudden flash of inspiration?) </>
Blood of a Deep Sea Spearfish

source_cn: 渎神者暂时完成了修行，从无尽遥远的时间与空间之外归来，或许，这将是再一次浩劫的征兆？
ref_en: The Blasphemer has temporarily completed his cultivation and returned from beyond the infinitely distant time and space. Perhaps this is a sign of another catastrophe?

source_cn: 演出开始啦！诸位就永远留在这吧。
ref_en: The performance has begun! Everyone, stay here forever.

source_cn: 猩红遗物·绑可通过击杀<Highlight>猎龙之城中的超凡生物</>获取，当被敌方玩家击杀时<Highlight>猩红遗物·绑不会掉落</>。\n可将其提交至<Highlight>【猎杀管家】处</>推进<Highlight>猎杀进度</>奖励。
ref_en: Scarlet Relic (Bound) can be obtained by killing Beyonder creatures in the <Highlight> City of Dragon Hunting </>. When killed by an enemy player, <Highlight> Scarlet Relic (Bound) will not be dropped </>. \n You can submit it to the <Highlight> [Hunting Butler] </> to advance <Highlight> hunting progress </> rewards.

source_cn: 真的吗……那太好了。<P_Heart>（略显歉疚）</>那片领地一直都缺少打理，也没有正式开始什么建设。您出1000苏勒，我想就已经很合适了。
ref_en: Really? That would be wonderful. <P_Heart> (looking slightly apologetic) </> That land has always lacked maintenance, and no formal construction has started. I think 1000 soli would be quite appropriate.
Dense and numerous, more and more.

source_cn: 能够激活乌托邦剧院效果，连接秘偶小镇的特定秘偶。使用后可以获得金色品质的秘偶，<Highlight>卡尔·埃德加</>。
ref_en: Activates the Utopia Theater effect, connecting to a specific marionette from the Marionette Small Town. Upon use, you will obtain a gold-quality marionette: <Highlight>Karl Edgar</>.

source_cn: 薇薇安，你看这个！粉底碎花，野餐的时候铺在草地上肯定好看！
ref_en: Vivian, look at this! Pink background with floral prints, it would look great spread on the grass during a picnic!
Please select a reason for reporting.

source_cn: 通过神铸改装，可以改变车辆的<Highlight>涂装、车身、轮胎、车牌、引擎</>。
ref_en: Through God-forged modifications, you can change the vehicle's <Highlight>livery, body, tires, license plate, and engine</>.

source_cn: 那在这里休息一下，一会我们再去教堂。
ref_en: Then rest here for a while, we'll go to the church later.

source_cn: 那当然，这是戴里克主教大人给我布置的任务，编写《愚者圣典》的新章节。
ref_en: Of course, this is a quest assigned to me by Bishop Derrick, to write a new chapter for the "Book of the Fool".

source_cn: 锁定<h>绯红屏障</>，<h>开枪</>射击，尝试将之摧毁。
ref_en: Lock onto the <h>crimson barrier</> and <h>fire</> your gun to try and destroy it.

source_cn: 难得有这么刺激的生意，这次免费！
ref_en: It's rare to have such an exciting job, this one is free!
Collected all materials for the Notarization potion

source_cn:
主讲医师：康拉德医生
地点：廷根大学大礼堂
守护健康 保障安全 珍惜生命

Keynote Speaker: Dr. Conrad

ref_en: <DecH>Craftsmanship: </>Clean Cut · Solemn and Unadorned · Lightweight Uniform\nA classic deep blue uniform, a slender and sharp silhouette on the battlefield, representing the beginning of order.

source_cn: <DecH>工艺：</>白金织锦・枝蔓刺绣・精灵长袍\n黄金枝叶编织王冠，丛影深处自有不朽，藤蔓缠绕金箔，森林也将低眉。
ref_en: <DecH>Craftsmanship: </>Platinum Brocade · Branch Embroidery · Elf Robe\nGolden branches and leaves weave a crown; immortality exists in the depths of the shadows, vines entwine gold leaf, and the forest will also bow its head.

source_cn: <P_Heart>（嗯？是我的错觉吗，这位女士似乎在看向我？咳咳……是时候展现罗塞尔的魅力了。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart>(Hmm? Is it my imagination, or is this lady looking at me? Cough, cough... it's time to show Roselle's charm.)</>

source_cn: <P_Heart>（我想想，第一个出现的纪元是……）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart>(Let me think, the first epoch to appear was...)</>
{{PlayerName}}, do you have time right now?

source_cn: 什么时候才能成为正式的咖啡师呢？要不下班后去占卜俱乐部算算……
ref_en: When will I be able to become a formal barista? Maybe I should go to the Divination Club after work and calculate...

source_cn: 什么？不，您幻听了。我是说，我不想，呃，我不想工作了。
ref_en: What? No, you have auditory hallucinations. I mean, I don't want to, uh, I don't want to work anymore.

source_cn: 今夜琴声温柔-玩家回归现实
ref_en: Gentle Piano Music Tonight - The player returns to reality

source_cn: 他们都是活生生的人，也和你们一样，有自己的家人和朋友……这样的结局对他们而言同样是一场悲剧。
ref_en: They were all living, breathing people, and just like you, they had their own families and friends... Such an ending is likewise a tragedy for them.

source_cn: 他们都遇难了……这是真的吗？
ref_en: They all perished... Is this true?

source_cn: 他是月亮仆从的成员，还在梦里举行过祭祀仪式……我是不是该继续追查下去？
ref_en: He is a member of the Moon Servant and even held a sacrificial ritual in a dream... Should I continue to investigate?

source_cn: 但是……污染扭曲了现实，普通的方法无法进入。
ref_en: But... the corruption has distorted reality, and normal methods cannot enter.
Who do you think is the most suspicious here?

source_cn: 使用后可结交奥黛丽·霍尔。
ref_en: After use, you can make a connection with Audrey Hall.

source_cn: 使用四叶手镯，挡住她的攻击！
ref_en: Use the Four-Leaf Bracelet to block her attack!
About the fatigue of the social season

source_cn: 净化污染词条后，可能会变为普通或者非凡词条。
ref_en: After purifying a corruption affix, it may change into a common or Beyonder affix.

source_cn: 参考图是风暴护符，需改成黄金材质，阳光的纹路
ref_en: The reference image is the Storm Charm; it needs to be changed to a gold material with sunlight patterns.

source_cn: 啊！罗珊已经出发了，我得在她之前赶到餐厅做好准备才行！
ref_en: Ah! Rozanne has already left, I must arrive at the restaurant before her to prepare!

source_cn: 喧闹的牌桌安静了一瞬，又再次喧闹了起来，你用当初挣脱出红茧的意志力狠狠地把纸牌往前掷去。
ref_en: The noisy card table went quiet for a moment, then became noisy again. You threw the cards forward fiercely with the willpower you used to break out of the red cocoon.

source_cn: 奈拉小姐，我全要了——这整间店里的香水。
ref_en: Miss Naila, I'll take them all—every perfume in this shop.

source_cn: 封印物已装备，无法操作。
ref_en: Sealed Artifact is equipped and cannot be operated.

source_cn: 小心！即将迎来全场伤害！
ref_en: Watch out! Full-field damage is coming!

source_cn: 幻化后无法行动和使用技能
ref_en: Unable to move or use skills after transforming

source_cn: 开启灵体之线辅助瞄准
ref_en: Enable Spirit Body Threads Aim Assist

source_cn: 很香，希望小黛西也能闻到
ref_en: It smells good, I hope little Daisy can smell it too

source_cn: 怠于职守、未完成周安魂次数者，直觉属性降低，直至重新履行周目标方可恢复。
ref_en: Those who are negligent in their duties and fail to complete the weekly requiem count will have their Intuition attribute reduced until they fulfill the weekly goal again.

source_cn: 您需要先撤销%s的职位，方可进行此操作
ref_en: You must revoke %s's position before performing this action.

source_cn: 我正在经历我的第二个三十五岁。时间在我的指尖穿过，我却怎样都抓不住它。
ref_en: I am currently experiencing my second thirty-five years. Time slips through my fingertips, yet I cannot grasp it no matter how I try.

source_cn: 战场上存在六座<Disable>守护雕像</>，雕像初始处于无敌状态，在二阶段米尔贡根释放四象守护时，雕像会按顺序解除无敌状态。每存在一座雕像，米尔贡根获得一定<Disable>锁血</>效果，需要摧毁全部雕像，米尔贡根才能被击杀。
ref_en: There are six <Disable>Guardian Statues</> on the battlefield. The statues are initially invincible. During the second phase when Milgongen releases Four Symbols Protection, the statues will lose their invincibility in sequence. For every statue that exists, Milgongen gains a certain <Disable>health-lock</> effect. All statues must be destroyed before Milgongen can be killed.
Warrior - Dual Blades Basic Attack Phase 2

source_cn: 所以我连夜收拾行李搬走了，看他还怎么用手杖捶门……喂，你为什么不说话？
ref_en: So I packed my luggage overnight and moved out. Let's see how he can use his cane to pound on the door... Hey, why aren't you talking?

押宝·食铺失效，本站不是【食铺】，物产出售价格-40%
ref_en: Bet: Shop failed, this station is not [Shop], product selling price -40%

ref_en: When holding an Attack increase effect, restore your own HP by <NumYellow>150.0%</> of your Attack. If holding a Defense increase effect, gain a Protective Shield that absorbs damage equal to 20.0% of your Max HP, lasting for 15 seconds.

source_cn: 是啊，为什么……为什么我会这么做?
ref_en: Yeah, why... why did I do this?

source_cn: 是的，这是我们用来包裹的纸张。但我没见过这个乐谱。
ref_en: Yes, this is the paper we use for wrapping. But I haven't seen this musical score before.

source_cn: 死亡咏叹第二节-被拉着跳舞
ref_en: Death's Requiem Part 2 - Being Pulled into a Dance

source_cn: 滚回弗萨克去，别让我再看到你！
ref_en: Get back to Feysac, and don't let me see you again!

source_cn: 瑞尔比伯释放2-049，使周围玩家进入<Disable>滞涩状态10秒</>。
ref_en: Riel Bieber releases 2-049, causing nearby players to enter a <Disable>Stagnant state for 10 seconds</>.

source_cn: 生活总是这样，有分歧，有和解，不是吗？
ref_en: Life is always like this—there are disagreements and reconciliations, isn't it?

source_cn: 由通体洁白的大理石板构成，细腻的纹理搭配恰到好处的金属装饰，为门预留方形空隙。
ref_en: Constructed from pure white marble slabs, with delicate textures paired with perfectly placed metal decorations, leaving a square gap for the door.

ref_en: I know, Mother... just let me listen a little longer.
Action closes interface after waiting time

ref_en: Please wait for Arrodes to finish replying.
Investigate the Puppet at the Scene

source_cn: 身怀巨款，担惊受怕的赶脚
ref_en: Feeling anxious and terrified while carrying a fortune.

ref_en: This place is easy to defend and hard to attack; settling down here should be a good choice, at least it can block those monsters...

ref_en: Follow this road north, and turn east at the intersection.

source_cn: <Italic>——有什么东西在你的皮肤下燃烧，把你从内到外染成猩红的月色。 你的力量远超常人，那些想要束缚你的枷锁，在你眼中不过是笑话。 可你的人性也在逐渐流失，你的认知开始错乱，无法感知到敌友的区别。 你的非凡之力在涌动，却不听你的命令。 你的躯体在发出暗红的光，就像一根即将烧断的引线。你已在危险的边缘，下一步，就是深渊。</>
ref_en: <Italic>—Something is burning beneath your skin, dyeing you from the inside out in the color of a scarlet moon. Your strength far exceeds that of an ordinary person; those shackles that sought to bind you are nothing but a joke in your eyes. Yet, your humanity is also gradually slipping away; your perception is becoming distorted, and you cannot distinguish between friend and foe. Your Beyonder powers are surging, but they no longer obey your commands. Your body is emitting a dark red light, like a fuse about to burn out. You are on the edge of danger; the next step is the abyss.</>

source_cn:
——在那个世界里，梅高欧丝一战无人牺牲。圣堂随后给予守护了全廷根的值夜者小队任职贝克兰德的机会，但邓恩和弗莱都拒绝了。

      戴莉从贝克兰德赶回来时已是深夜，她照例拎了一瓶邓恩和弗莱都爱喝的酒。
      “所以，你真拒绝了圣堂的邀请？”她靠在桌边，目光落在邓恩脸上。
      邓恩抬起头，看向她。火光在他灰色的眼睛里轻轻晃了晃。
      “你比我更适合那里。”他说，声音平静而厚重，“在廷根，这里的人认得我，我也认得每一条街、每一扇窗。我想留在这里，继续守护着它。”
      弗莱默默给自己倒了一杯，举起来：“我也是。”
      戴莉沉默片刻，轻声笑了一下：“就知道你会这么说。”
      她拎过酒瓶也满上。三只杯子在壁炉前碰到一起，清脆的一声响。
      窗外的廷根，在不眠的守护者注视中，安安静静地睡着。
ref_en:
—In that world, no one sacrificed their life in the battle against Megose. The Cathedral subsequently gave the Nighthawks squad that guarded all of Tingen the opportunity to take up posts in Backlund, but Dunn and Frye both refused. 

      Daly returned from Backlund late at night; she brought a bottle of the wine that both Dunn and Frye loved, as was her custom. 
      "So, you really refused the Cathedral's invitation?" She leaned against the table, her gaze resting on Dunn's face. 
      Dunn looked up at her. The firelight flickered gently in his gray eyes. 
      "You are more suited for that place than I am," he said, his voice calm and heavy. "In Tingen, the people here know me, and I know every street, every window. I want to stay here and continue guarding it." 
      Frye silently poured himself a glass and raised it: "Me too." 
      Daly was silent for a moment, then laughed softly: "I knew you would say that." 
      She grabbed the bottle and filled her own glass. Three glasses clinked together in front of the fireplace with a crisp sound. 
      Outside the window, Tingen slept quietly under the watchful eyes of the sleepless Guardians.

source_cn:
伯德温·威瑟尔成为见习骑士时，得到了一枚护符。赏赐他的人说：“上一任主人戴着它从战场活着回来了，祝你也有这样的运气。”
他携带这枚护符历经无数战役，一路晋升，创立了自己的苍鹰骑士团。他受过很多次伤，但每一次倒下都有人把他拖回来，就像他拖回过很多人一样。
后来，伯德温将这枚护符赠予了麾下最得力的一名骑士。再后来，这枚护符又从这位骑士手中传递给了下一个见习骑士。每一位送走它的骑士都战功赫赫，每一位接过它的骑士都还年轻。
交接时，他们往往只说一句：“活着回来。”
对方答：“你也是。”
于是二人翻身上马，走向不同道路，直到马蹄扬起的尘土迷蒙双眼。
ref_en:
When Baldwin Wetherell became a squire, he received an amulet. The person who rewarded him said: "The previous owner wore it and returned from the battlefield alive; I wish you the same luck." 
 He carried this amulet through countless battles, advancing all the way, and founded his own Goshawk Knights. He had been injured many times, but every time he fell, someone dragged him back, just as he had dragged many people back. 
 Later, Baldwin gifted this amulet to the most capable knight under his command. Later still, this amulet was passed from this knight to the next squire. Every knight who sent it away had great military achievements, and every knight who received it was still young. 
 When handing it over, they usually only said one sentence: "Come back alive." 
 The other replied: "You too." 
 So the two turned onto their horses and walked on different paths, until the dust raised by the horse's hooves blurred their eyes.
You feel a wave of dizziness...

 In this game of chess with the Sauron Family, I won by a narrow margin. But they are indeed an ancient family that has survived since the Fourth Epoch; their foundation and accumulation are terrifyingly deep. If it weren't for the fact that Intis had been mired in chaos for a long time and the dissatisfaction of the people was growing, I would never have been able to ignite the sparks of riot and stand in my current position. 
 Next, it's time to gradually implement the policies I've been conceiving for a long time. Of course, first is—

Very eager to learn, not bad.

source_cn: 恭喜你，出色的完成了目标业绩，现在可以重新签订经销协议
ref_en: Congratulations, you have excellently completed your performance targets. You may now re-sign the distribution agreement.

source_cn: 我……我这一时半会出不去！村里多的是能借厕所的地方，你记好了——
ref_en: I... I can't get out for a while! There are plenty of places in the village to borrow a toilet, remember this—

source_cn: 我当然得陪着她。虽然我只是个“纤细敏感”的作家，但让她一个人去送死？
ref_en: Of course I had to accompany her. Although I am just a 'delicate and sensitive' writer, let her go to her death alone?

source_cn: 我每天都来这里等待，但是已经很久没有看见他了。
ref_en: I come here every day to wait, but I haven't seen him for a long time.

source_cn: 戒指被梅格夫人带走了！她多么幸运，能接受花海的祝福！
ref_en: The ring was taken by Mrs. Meg! How lucky she is to receive the blessing of the flower sea!

source_cn: 手工制作的木雕乐器，刀法笨拙，并不精致。
ref_en: A handmade wooden musical instrument; the carving technique is clumsy and not refined.

source_cn: 拯救艾玛（提示：灵活使用护身盾）
ref_en: Save Emma (Hint: Use the Protective Shield flexibly).

source_cn: 持续期间不能通过界面按钮自主复活，不能被友方复活，作为奶妈不能自活（可以被烧尸体）
ref_en: During the duration, one cannot autonomously resurrect via interface buttons, cannot be resurrected by allies, and as a healer, one cannot self-resurrect (can have the corpse burned).

source_cn: 桌边散落着几个药瓶。最前面的药瓶小巧精致，里面已经空了，内壁只残留少量药物碎屑的痕迹。
ref_en: Several medicine bottles are scattered around the table. The small, exquisite bottle at the front is empty, with only traces of medicine residue left on the inner walls.

source_cn: 桥梁世界观文字版9-描述待定
ref_en: Bridge Worldview Text Version 9 - Description Pending

source_cn: 每一次摇摆，都是命运给出的隐秘答案。
ref_en: Every sway is a secret answer given by fate.

source_cn: 码头区必打卡美食，好吃的海鲜烩饭配姜啤！
ref_en: Must-try food in the dock area, delicious seafood risotto with ginger beer!

source_cn: 米顿-内部资料后置氛围

ref_en: I'm sure there is, let me think...

source_cn: 要和其他非凡者切磋一下吗？
ref_en: Do you want to spar with other Beyonders?

source_cn: 该成员已经离开俱乐部
ref_en: This member has already left the club.

source_cn: 还有这儿，什么海盗女王救贵族小姐？根本没这回事！格尔曼救下的是一位被绑架的议员之子，哪来的什么小姐！
ref_en: And here, what Pirate Queen saving a noble lady? That never happened! Gehrman saved the son of a kidnapped senator, where did a lady come from!

source_cn: 这么大的船，要是撞上点什么就要命了，比如冰山……
ref_en: A ship this big, it would be fatal if it hit something, like an iceberg...

source_cn: 那可不是一些容易说服的人，完全能猜想到您辛劳的处境，愿女神保佑您！
ref_en: Those are not easy people to persuade. I can fully imagine your difficult situation. May the Goddess bless you!

source_cn: 采集指定TemplateID的采集物  玩家根据InstanceID列表创建公有对象（大世界不生效）  延迟执行  对象传送到指定场景里的指定位置（玩家支持跨场景传送，Npc只能同场景传送）
ref_en: Gather the specified TemplateID collection item; player creates public object based on InstanceID list (does not take effect in the open world); delayed execution; object teleports to the specified location in the specified scene (players support cross-scene teleportation, NPCs can only teleport within the same scene).

ref_en: Not only that, occasionally people say it screams... it's probably just a rumor.

ref_en: Compete against the charmed target's Charm stat; succeed in the check to gain a 5% score bonus.

ref_en: Riel isn't that kind of person!

source_cn: 告诉外面的人……好好活着。在阳光下，替我们多看几眼这个世界。
ref_en: Tell the people outside... live well. Under the sunlight, take a few more looks at this world for us.

source_cn: 因为承受不住力量而发狂，因为听见未知存在的呓语而堕落，因为精神崩溃而人格扭曲。
ref_en: Going mad because they cannot withstand the power, falling because they hear the whispers of unknown existences, and having their personalities distorted due to mental collapse.

Upon summoning and every <Highlight>6</> seconds thereafter, the baboon will apply a random buff to teammates within 30 meters. \nRandom buffs: buffdisc(*id), lasting <Highlight>6</> seconds; buffdisc(*id), lasting <Highlight>6</> seconds; buffdisc(*id), lasting <Highlight>6</> seconds;

ref_en: A successful proposal in the sea of flowers brings eternal happiness, but what if the proposal fails?

巨人伤害：半径9米的扇形区域
ref_en: Giant Damage: Sector area with a 9m radius

ref_en: Guide the Mystery Pryer to step on the eyes!

source_cn: 恐惧吧、忏悔吧，在生不如死中度过每一天吧！
ref_en: Be afraid, repent, and spend every day in a fate worse than death!
Take a look, is there anything you like?

source_cn: 您真是位善良的女士。谢谢您的好意，愿您今日顺利。
ref_en: You are truly a kind lady. Thank you for your kindness, may your day go smoothly.

source_cn: 我想买些茉莉放在家里，这样也许能使心情好一些。
ref_en: I'd like to buy some jasmine to keep at home; perhaps it will help improve my mood.

source_cn: 我是怎么穿越的？我只是个生活在21世纪的普通人，最近除了倒霉点，也没什么特殊啊。
ref_en: How did I transmigrate? I'm just an ordinary person living in the 21st century. Recently, besides being a bit unlucky, there's nothing special.

ref_en: It was my father's great vision, existing within the Crown of Knowledge, and now it has also been corrupted by the Mother Goddess.

ref_en: Get a family magazine, wishing you a worry-free day!

ref_en: The dangerous aura in the dream wasn't powerful, but it was somewhat strange.

ref_en: Let’s get to know each other formally, I am “Spirit Medium” Daly.

ref_en: Are you really sure you want to touch it? Your sanity will drop to a relatively dangerous range.

source_cn: 祝你们好运，相信你们能摧毁魔镜，拯救大家。
ref_en: Good luck. I believe you can destroy the Mirror of Despair and save everyone.

source_cn: 笛子？什么笛子，我从没见过尤朵拉吹笛子。
ref_en: A flute? What flute? I have never seen Yodora play a flute.

ref_en: John: <P_Heart>(lowering his voice)</> Come over quickly, keep your footsteps light!

ref_en: Since then, the City of Silver has been ruled by the 'Council of Six,' with the elder in the highest position honored as the 'Chief,' and the other five being equal in rank.

ref_en: The Dancing King Baboon Brother gradually becomes excited, continuously targeting different players to charge. Each charge <Disable> deals control damage </> to players in the path and leaves behind a <Disable> fire path </> that deals continuous damage.

ref_en: Sasrir summons multiple avatars to transport black and white Chaos Energy to its main body. <Disable>All Chaos Energy that touches Sasrir will add 1 stack of strengthening to it.</> After a period of time, Sasrir releases Blasphemer's Death, dealing continuous field-wide damage. Each stack of Chaos Energy enhancement increases this damage by 20%.
